hooks.command: [ -n "$TMUX" ] && name=$(tmux display-message -p '#W') && clean=$(printf '%s' "$name" | sed 's/^[⏸✓⚙❓] //') && tmux rename-window "⚙ $clean"; true

[ -n "$ZELLIJ" ] && { f="/tmp/zellij_claude.${ZELLIJ_PANE_ID:-$ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME}"; [ -f "$f" ] || printf '%s' "${ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME:-claude}" > "$f"; clean=$(sed 's/^[⏸✓⚙❓] //' "$f"); printf '%s' "$clean" > "$f"; zellij action rename-tab "⚙ $clean"; }; true
